strings.ESQ_VEN_invasion_tt:
------------------------------------
{guy_getflag} Guyana will fall without aid. The loss will cripple the OFN's credibility and encourage fascism to spread in South America. The unprepared OFN forces will need to maintain control of Georgetown to receive reinforcements, push back the {ven_getflag} Venezuelan invaders, and keep the torch aflame.
------------------------------------
The success of the Venezuelan offensive will be decided by the ghosts of the last decade.

The strength of the regional coalition rallying to Guyana's aid will be directly proportional to the OFN's past victories in both proxy conflicts and intelligence operations. Likewise, where it has faltered, Venezuela shall find its path significantly less contested.
